capabilities: Sync a whole vault across devices through a self-hosted Synkk server
Edit Markdown together in real time with Yjs CRDTs and remote carets
Encrypt vault contents client-side with AES-256-GCM for zero-knowledge sync
Assign path-level read_write, read_only, and hidden permissions per member and device
Dehydrate large attachments into lightweight stubs and hydrate them on demand
extras: Also publishes a vault as an interactive Livewire web portal with fuzzy search and backlinks; includes a first-sync migration wizard with a 20% deletion-abort safety shield; Obsidian staff have not manually reviewed the plugin.
motivation: The author built it for teams and individuals who need private infrastructure, access control, and collaboration "without turning every user into a Git operator."
problem: Teams need private, self-hosted vault sync with member/device access control and real-time collaboration, without every member having to operate Git.

relations.evidence: Real-time concurrent Markdown editing powered by Yjs CRDTs over Laravel Reverb

requires.name: Synkk team membership and device token

summary: Self-hosted team vault sync with real-time Yjs co-editing, zero-knowledge E2EE, path-level permissions, QR device pairing, and recoverable file history.
